rulings: baton.request persists its request and publishes baton.requested before using the existing DeliveryService.send once, from requester to definition.created_by, with the legacy request notice body.
Missing or dissolved keeper returns notice:null without a delivery admission; the committed request and event remain.
Use actual receipt strength: idle or working Pi/Omp extension-stream admission is queued until ReaderRead (#374 honest-receipt rule); confirmed socket/native injection may report delivered.
Unverified uses only existing core::liveness::alive Dead/Recycled process-incarnation evidence; native stale-external witness is a recycled binding, never a restored heartbeat-age threshold.
Send error, Held or Refused does not erase the committed request; E-RS-PARTIAL carries committed=true, event_published=true, request and seq. Publication failure occurs before any send.
Self-send still goes through existing delivery refusal; no special self-send bypass or second sender.
